title: FAB: A First-Order AB-based Gradient Algorithm for Distributed Bilevel Optimization over Time-Varying Directed Graphs
summary: Distributed optimization over time-varying directed graphs has shown promising performance in addressing challenges posed by complex communication constraints in real-world scenarios. In many practical settings, however, the direct application of distributed optimization algorithms encounters additional difficulties, most notably hyperparameter tuning, which our empirical observations suggest can be effectively mitigated by integrating bilevel optimization.
